candidates.statement: Gateway checkout POST /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order POST /v1/orders returns 500. Traces and logs show each 502 checkout correlated with a 500 from order, so the fault originates in the order service, not the gateway.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side root cause (db, payment, inventory) not observed; only gateway-side evidence available.

report.explanation: Gateway 502s on /v1/checkout are consistently paired with 500 responses from the order service on /v1/orders across traces and logs. The gateway itself is healthy (readyz 200). The bounded cause is an order-service 500 propagating as a gateway 502; the specific order-side failure is not yet observed.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces for POST /v1/orders 500 to identify the failing internal dependency
Order service metrics for downstream calls (payment, inventory, postgresql) to localize the 500
